mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate clindamycin's neuromuscular blocking effects and increase risk of nephrotoxic synergy.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and neuromuscular status closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible or adjust dosing based on renal parameters.
